statement: The two published 0x057e:0x0337 USB enumeration dumps agree on two interrupt endpoints on interface 0: IN address 0x81 with maximum packet size 37 bytes and OUT address 0x02 with maximum packet size 5 bytes, each declaring bInterval 8 at full speed. The nominal 8 ms USB polling interval does not establish measured device report production, consumer latency or host-overclock behavior.

applicability.revision: public reports for 0x057e:0x0337; hardware revision unverified
applicability.scope: Endpoint descriptors and declared full-speed polling interval, not measured runtime cadence
